finish.summary: 4-cell compact tray, each cell holds a full-depth drained bin filled with soil and seedlings to show seed-starting use; capped and bolted, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
**Build:** 4-cell cluster (0,0,0; 1,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,-1,0) with full-depth drained bins in each, filled with soil and planted to demonstrate seed-starting use. Capped and joint-bolted.

Check `check_build: ok, meshClash clear`.

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| At least four cells | met | 4 pieces: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full |
| Each with a draining bin | met | bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain — all `hex-bin-full-drain` (drained floor) |
| Seed-starting tray function | met | Soil + seedlings planted in each bin via fill_and_plant (prop:1-4) shows tray use; bins are removable trays hanging on cell rims |

**Print:** 1945g / 2778 min / 22 parts inc caps/jointBolts. Material properties (waterproofing, strength) are not verified by configurator — shape provides drainage only.

Outcome: built
